## Scope

The `realworld/` folder is the **RealWorld conformance pack**. It is not a runnable application. It defines OpenAPI and UI contracts, shared Playwright E2E specs, Bruno and Hurl API runners, the Astro/Starlight documentation site, and branding assets. Implementations embed or vendor this tree and must conform to `specs/`; see [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) when this repo is a submodule. The repository root entry point is [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md); the INIT report is [../platform/init/INIT.md](../platform/init/INIT.md).

| Area | Path | Role |
|------|------|------|
| API contract and runners | [specs/api/README.md](specs/api/README.md), `specs/api/` | `openapi.yml`, Hurl source tests, generated `bruno/`, `run-api-tests-hurl.sh`, `run-api-tests-bruno.sh`, `hurl-to-bruno.js` |
| Frontend E2E contract | `specs/e2e/` | Domain `*.spec.ts`, `helpers/`, `playwright.base.ts`, selector and routing contract in `specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md` |
| Documentation | `docs/` | Starlight site; scripts in `docs/package.json` |
| Workflows | `Makefile` | `documentation-setup`, `documentation-dev`, `documentation-build`, `bruno-generate`, `bruno-check` per [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) |
| Contributor process | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) | Issues, PRs, commit message format |
| Local E2E skills | `skills/` | Pack-specific Playwright workflows beside this file |

Angular implementation work lives under `../src/`; see [../src/AGENTS.md](../src/AGENTS.md) and [../src/app/AGENTS.md](../src/app/AGENTS.md). System map: [../ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md). REST and UI contracts: [../CONTRACTS.md](../CONTRACTS.md), [../DOMAIN.md](../DOMAIN.md).

## Read first

Read these before you change anything under `realworld/`:

1. [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — spec hub rules: use `bun`, Hurl is API source of truth, do not hand-edit `specs/api/bruno/`, fix implementations not specs when vendored.
2. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — submission and commit conventions for upstream RealWorld changes.
3. [specs/api/README.md](specs/api/README.md) — how to run Hurl and Bruno against `HOST`, and how `openapi.yml` relates to the suites.
4. `README.md` — overview of the tree.
5. `Makefile` — docs and Bruno targets; `make bruno-check` mirrors CI.
6. `docs/package.json` — Astro dev and production build scripts.
7. `specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts` — shared Playwright defaults; the host repo merges this at the root.
8. **`specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`** — read before any E2E spec or helper change: required routes, DOM selectors, `localStorage` key `jwtToken`, and `window.__conduit_debug__`.
9. `specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts` — `BROWSER_API`, `EXTERNAL_API`, `TEST_MODE`, and test-mode gates used across specs.
10. `specs/api/openapi.yml` — canonical REST surface aligned with Hurl.
11. `.github/workflows/bruno-check.yml` — CI runs Bruno sync via `make bruno-check`.

E2E layout: domain specs live beside `helpers/` under `specs/e2e/` (for example `articles.spec.ts`, `auth.spec.ts`, `navigation.spec.ts`, `error-handling.spec.ts`, `health.spec.ts`, `null-fields.spec.ts`). Shared flows import from `./helpers/`; SPA-only HTTP mocking uses `test.skip(!BROWSER_API, …)` per [../GUIDELINES.md](../GUIDELINES.md).

## Commands

All statuses are **documented** (from [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md), `Makefile`, `docs/package.json`, and API shell scripts).

| Task | Command | Notes |
|------|---------|--------|
| Docs install | `make documentation-setup` | `cd docs && bun install` |
| Docs dev | `make documentation-dev` or `cd docs && bun run dev` | Starlight preview |
| Docs build | `make documentation-build` or `cd docs && bun run build` | `astro check && astro build` |
| API Hurl (source) | `HOST=http://localhost:8000 ./specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh` | From `specs/api/`; see [specs/api/README.md](specs/api/README.md) |
| API Bruno (generated) | `HOST=http://localhost:8000 ./specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh` | Same `HOST`; do not hand-edit `specs/api/bruno/` |
| Regenerate Bruno | `make bruno-generate` | Edit Hurl only, then regenerate |
| Verify Bruno in sync | `make bruno-check` | Mirrors `.github/workflows/bruno-check.yml` |
| E2E against SPA (root) | `bun run test:e2e` | Suite under `specs/e2e/`; see [../TESTING.md](../TESTING.md) |
| Focused E2E file | `bun run test:e2e -- <path>` | See [../skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md](../skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md) |

Use **`bun`**, not `npm`/`node`, for work inside this tree ([CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)).

## Rules that apply

Binding agent rules: [../RULES.md](../RULES.md). When this tree is vendored for conformance testing, **do not change spec or test files to make a failing implementation pass** ([CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)). Change Hurl under `specs/api/hurl/`, not committed `specs/api/bruno/`, then `make bruno-generate` or `make bruno-check`.

## Hooks

Repository hooks (format, tests): [../HOOKS.md](../HOOKS.md). CI Bruno check is active via `.github/workflows/bruno-check.yml` (`make bruno-check`).

## Check a change

Use the narrowest check for the area you touched:

| You changed | Verify |
|-------------|--------|
| `docs/` content or config | `make documentation-build` (or `cd docs && bun run build`) |
| `specs/api/hurl/` or `hurl-to-bruno.js` | `make bruno-check`; optionally `HOST=… ./specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh` |
| `specs/e2e/` specs or helpers | Align with `specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`; from repo root `bun run test:e2e` or [../skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md](../skills/run-focused-e2e-spec/SKILL.md) |
| `specs/e2e/health.spec.ts` | [skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md) verification |
| `specs/e2e/null-fields.spec.ts` | [skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md) verification |
| `specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts` (invalid token) | [skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md) verification |
| `specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts` (register/login/logout) | [skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-auth-flow-spec/SKILL.md) verification |
| `specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts` | [skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-article-crud-spec/SKILL.md) verification |
| OpenAPI only | Update Hurl when behavior is test-covered; run Hurl against a backend when applicable |
